entries.title: A text box in a card stays in view while you type on an iPhone or iPad
entries.body: On your iPhone and iPad, tapping a text box inside a card no longer scrolls it away behind the keyboard. The card now scrolls so the box sits above the keyboard, and you can see what you type.
entries.noPicture: The fix is in the iPhone and iPad app, which the desktop app's note picture cannot show.
